Lowercase ASCII text, trim it, replace each group of non-alphanumeric characters by one hyphen, remove leading/trailing hyphens. Empty input returns an empty string. Do not change tests. Implement both files in one task.

subtasks.title: Implement and export slugify
subtasks.goal:
Add the string utility using named ES module exports.
Absent src/slug.mjs → create exported function slugify(text): lowercase text, trim whitespace, replace each group matching /[^a-z0-9]+/g with '-', then remove leading/trailing hyphens using /^-+|-+$/g; return the resulting string, including '' for empty input.
src/index.mjs version-only exports → preserve export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs'.
Keep test/slug.test.mjs and package.json unchanged; add no dependencies.

Simple task (complexity 1, risk 1).
